text: 円形吸収体の特性線参照 Circular-absorber characteristic reference 円形吸収体の特性線参照 I(x,y,t)=I_in(y)*exp(-kappa*ell_circle(x,y))*1_(x<t); Pxx=E,Pyy=Pzz=0 for the+xray. 2D空間に3D角度測度を用い、c=1の軸に整列した光線を扱います。実際の符号付き角度輸送と非線形の閉じたM1方程式をともに進めます。解析特性線の参照はRTE/S_Nに適用し、M1解全体の厳密参照とはしません。 Circular-absorber characteristic reference I(x,y,t)=I_in(y)*exp(-kappa*ell_circle(x,y))*1_(x<t); Pxx=E,Pyy=Pzz=0 for the+xray. 2Dspace with3Dangular measure,c1. Pure aligned rays; actual signed-angle transport and nonlinear closed M1 both evolved. The analytic characteristic reference applies to RTE/S_N,not to the entire M1 solution. shadow-absorber2d 円形吸収体の特性線参照 Circular-absorber characteristic reference 厳密解・参照解 参照解 reference solution 解析解 Analytic reference
